title: Event (one line of records/events.jsonl)
description: What happens, in order. Append-only: never edit or delete a line or the file. A recording error is corrected by a record_correction event that points to the record by seq (or, for a line that is not valid JSON, by line number). The common fields (seq, ts, session, identity, captured_by, refs, drill, origin) are in common.schema.json.

type.description: born, witness_created, close_out, integrity_repair, unrecorded_session, sync, instance_launched and study_configured are written only by the seed's scripts. study_configured: at birth, fos_init made this organization a research configuration (org/STUDY.json), for a study only. instance_launched: the founder's launch of an agent app as a role instance (scripts/fos_launch.py), with what the founder said it runs on (launch_id, launched_instance, launched). sync: fos_sync brought the folder back in line with its witness; it names what it kept and what it set aside in the witness folder. unrecorded_session: the close-out found no session_start since the last close-out, and records the gap (and, if nothing changed at all, the founder's answer to whether a session took place). role_ran: a role was called by its trigger; refs hold the role ID. source_fetched: a member fetched a web page, which the founder allowed in the agent app, and saved it in sources/ (url, saved_as; saved_sha256 is filled in). Every fetch is logged; what a member remembers is never a source. record_correction: points to a record that was written wrongly (corrects). operator_access: a host operator opened the organization; written by the host.

corrects.description: record_correction only. The record being corrected: its file, and its seq, or the line number when the line is not valid JSON.

saved_as.description: source_fetched only. Where the fetched page was saved, under sources/.

saved_sha256.description: source_fetched only. The SHA-256 of the saved file when the fetch was logged; filled in by fos_log.

should_read.description: record_correction only. What the corrected record should have said, in words or as JSON text. It is for readers; it does not replace the original.

app_instructions.description: instance_launched only, when the founder named them (fos_launch --app-instructions). The agent app's own instruction and configuration files for this launch: each file's name and SHA-256, or a folder's name (ending in /), its number of files and one SHA-256 over their relative paths and hashes. Never their content or full paths.

seed.description: born only. The seed release this organization was born from, and the birth hash: the git tree id of the organization's first commit, which equals the seed's tree at that release.
